description: Fork of NicholasBly/youtube-webos (ad-free YouTube for LG webOS TVs), branched at upstream 0.8.1.
divergence: Dropped the entire legacy webOS 3-6 / Chrome 38 / ES5 build; only the modern Chrome 87 target ships
Removed babel.config.js, legacy browserslist targets, core-js-pure, @babel/runtime-corejs3, regenerator-runtime, babel-plugin-polyfill-*, whatwg-fetch, and all polyfills
Deleted the twemoji emoji-fix code path entirely
Converted config.js to typed config.ts with a 200 ms debounced localStorage write flushed on pagehide
Bundles all icons, logos and fonts locally already
Added a node:test suite and CI; does not use ad-hoc .cjs bench harnesses
app_api already gates debug logs behind a flag with poll backoff and timeout
Fixed the back-button issue #159 independently with an isAtTopLevel guard
Already fixed the options-panel ReferenceError and shortcut debounce
Has its own README, repo.json and version numbering; nothing is distributed, so no migration shims are needed
